question: Which liṅga types are specified as having an upward head?
premises: The previously stated vāruṇa liṅga is included.
Both are described as endowed with an upward head.
inference: The previously stated vāruṇa and yākṣa liṅgas are endowed with an upward head.
plain_english: The previously mentioned vāruṇa liṅga and the yākṣa liṅga are endowed with an upward head.
